ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Predominantly low-intensity (black) with a low global contrast ratio; high-intensity (white) pixels are restricted to approximately 5% of the total visible surface area, concentrated at the distal tips and in linear streaks.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Primary surface is a continuous low-intensity black field. High-contrast contiguous geometric blobs are mapped to the extreme lateral tips of both lobes. Sparse high-intensity focal points are scattered across the central and medial lobe regions.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep V-shaped central depression with a clearly defined vertex; estimated interior angle of 65 degrees relative to the horizontal plane of the lobe peaks.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, low-amplitude serrations observed along the entire trailing edge boundary, with more pronounced pixel-amplitude irregularities on the medial portion of the left lobe.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Outer margins exhibit a consistent convex trajectory extending from the median notch to the lateral distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Dense clusters of roughly circular, high-contrast white and cream pixel groups (consistent with barnacle colonization) localized at the extreme distal margins of both lobes.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Multiple distinct, unaligned linear white pixel disruptions (rake marks) are visible across the surface, with a high concentration of parallel diagonal streaks on the upper right lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Parallel linear rake marks across the fluke surface and non-uniform, jagged serrations along the trailing edge boundary.
other_distinctive_markers: Heavy accumulation of high-contrast textured clusters localized exclusively on the extreme lateral points of the fluke lobes.
